DHAKA, Sept 21, 2022 (BSS) - Country Director of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to Bangladesh Edimon Ginting today noted that the overall trend of the country's economy is 'positive'.

"The overall trend of the economy is still positive. But, if you can make the right policy, then you can make the economy stronger going forward," he said while responding to a volley of questions at the Bangladesh Resident Mission of ADB in the capital.
